text: I can walk a request path hop by hop and name every single point of failure, including config, certificates and people.
I can explain why redundant copies that share a zone, a deploy, an input or a dependency still fail together, and how to make them independent.
I can classify each dependency of a request as critical or optional and compute how much availability degradation buys (for example 0.999⁵ versus 0.999²).
I can decide whether a check should fail open or fail closed and justify it by the cost of a wrong yes versus a wrong no.
I can spot a fallback that would overload a different system and replace it with one that does less or runs on the normal path.
I can size statically stable capacity across N zones (1 ÷ (N − 1) extra) and explain why it avoids depending on the control plane during an outage.
